about.statement: I'm happiest in the backend, sitting with the people who run a process until I understand it, then designing the system around what they actually do.
about.aside: Alongside the enterprise work I've built public products people use every day, like And1 Nepal, Job Sewa and Daily Sewa.

principles.title: I write decisions down
principles.body: Short decision records and project guides mean the next developer can find the reasoning without having to find me.

principles.title: I'd rather be readable than clever
principles.body: Clear layering, consistent naming and small changes that are easy to review.

principles.title: I build things that can be debugged at 2am
principles.body: Structured logs, sensible retries on jobs and database calls, and deployments you can reason about from the logs.

tools: Mostly ==C#== and ==ASP.NET Core Web API== with **EF Core**, on **MSSQL**, **PostgreSQL** or **Oracle**. For live data I reach for **WebSockets**, **Server-Sent Events** and background services. On the front end I use **Next.js** and **Svelte**, with **Flutter** for mobile. I still maintain **Web Forms** and **Razor Pages** apps, ship with **Azure DevOps**, **PowerShell** and **Docker**, and have built games in **Unity**.
